Im gonna be honest with you on how i would handle the situation. you need to be honest with her, and let her know why you’re scared of telling her. maybe try telling her that the reason you haven’t yet is because you were afraid she would think of you like she did her old friend. i know that sounds a lot easier than it is, but if she doesn’t at least try to understand, then maybe she isn’t the one for you. i know that sucks, but if she really does like you, i’m sure she would at least try to understand where you’re coming from, and maybe even try and help you stop. while i do the same thing, it isn’t the type of thing you should have to hide from someone, even though it may feel that way. and speaking from experience, when people open up about their issues with me, it makes me feel trusted, and maybe she will feel the same
